field_evidence.description: Conversion of two semi-detached dwellings into a single detached dwelling, including the construction of a feature entrance with hipped roof, two-storey side and rear extension, rear dormer window, front boundary retaining wall, creation of a level access and driveway, installation of entrance gates, and erection of a detached single-storey garage and covered patio area to rear

geometry_limitation: Official planning page exposes no machine-readable application point or building footprint; GeoJSON geometry is null and no location geometry was inferred.
identity_limitation: The source explicitly identifies a detached single-storey garage; other described works concern existing dwellings or non-building works and are not separately counted.
evidence_slice: Rotherham Metropolitan Borough Council planning application RB2026/1338 at 11 Richard Road Moorgate: application received 21/09/2026 and registered 22/09/2026; the official public planning page states no decision and explicitly includes erection of a detached single-storey garage. This batch counts only that detached garage as a distinct planned building; conversion of the two existing dwellings into one dwelling, extensions, dormer, retaining wall, access, driveway, gates and covered patio are not counted as separate buildings. The official page exposes no machine-readable application point or building footprint, so no geometry is inferred.
